definition: The initial file is compact. ISO3 codes in seeded have records but are not complete. Every ISO3 in claude/atlas/registry/countries.json that is absent from seeded is unstarted. The first worldwide run expands this into one coverage entry per ISO3.

last_run.note: A mistaken change-led run staged 15 valid-looking seed records. They still require de-duplication and schema migration by the worldwide builder. That run did not establish complete coverage for any country.
